description: Zeck infrastructure secret-reference inventory (D1.0 section 14). Provider credentials are represented ONLY as opaque secret references of the form zeck-secret://<environment>/<name>. Reference URIs are environment-scoped by construction, so production material is never addressable from a non-production environment. Values are materialized outside source control (operator/CI environment or external secret manager) and are resolved immediately before an authorized adapter call. No secret plaintext is committed, logged, or returned by application APIs.

local.name: database-url
local.description: Local PostgreSQL connection string for the zeck_local database.

local.name: container-runner-token
local.description: Bearer credential of the local container runner daemon (optional; absent means the container substrate reports unavailable and container sandbox dispatch fails closed).

local.name: transport-token
local.description: PPR-008: Application transport credential (bearer token) the local authority-materialization composition binds when the environment materializes it — the materialized value (ZECK_TRANSPORT_TOKEN) plus ZECK_PREVIEW_APPLICATION_ID drive the preview authority seeding (deploy/preview-authorities.ts).

local.name: experience-token
local.description: Transport credential of the local experience surface (the console composition's projection token, materialized as ZECK_EXPERIENCE_TOKEN; unbound means the console serves its honest unauthenticated states).

local.name: livekit-api-key
local.description: PPR-009: The LiveKit server API key of this environment's realtime rail credential keypair (materialized as ZECK_LIVEKIT_API_KEY inside the rail adapter's own scope; the URL ZECK_LIVEKIT_URL is non-secret).

local.name: livekit-api-secret
local.description: PPR-009: The LiveKit server API secret of this environment's realtime rail credential keypair (materialized as ZECK_LIVEKIT_API_SECRET inside the rail adapter's own scope).

local.name: socketio-auth-secret
local.description: PPR-010: The local environment's socket.io rail auth secret (the ALTERNATE realtime rail's credential, materialized as ZECK_SOCKETIO_AUTH_SECRET inside the rail adapter's own scope; the listen coordinate ZECK_SOCKETIO_URL is non-secret).

preview.name: transport-token
preview.description: PPR-008: The preview plane's application transport credential (the Lead's directly-materialized journey token). The bootstrap composition binds bearer authentication over its materialized value (ZECK_TRANSPORT_TOKEN) when the preview authority set materializes (ZECK_DATABASE_URL + ZECK_TRANSPORT_TOKEN + ZECK_PREVIEW_APPLICATION_ID): the transport principal/membership/credential rows are seeded idempotently at cold start, the durable credential row governs the token's validity (revocation disables it), and the deterministic sandbox substrate drives created executions to honest terminal receipts (see deploy/PUBLIC-DEPLOYMENT.md §14).

Distinct from experience-deploy-token (the Vercel deployment credential).
